understood_as: Implement one harmful PACK kernel whose only difference from fixed is c'=1 on a valid harvest with c>0, then run exactly three no-learning gates: paired damage of the frozen normal policies, a zero-loss three-delivery reference path from every natural start, and transition locality with loss exactly c. Do not start PPO, BC, teacher updates, checkpoint writing, hyperparameter sweeps, or automatic extensions.

kernel_contract.base: PACK fixed kernel; mutant record-rebuild grain duplication is disabled
kernel_contract.trigger: valid DO harvest and carried_grain c > 0
kernel_contract.oracle: physical_grain_total(before)-physical_grain_total(after)=c at B; zero kernel gap outside B

evaluation.failure_handling: retain every seed and episode; never select on observed damage

gates.actual_damage: For every predeclared seed 30-34: fixed mean loss is zero, harmful mean loss is positive, and harmful success rate and mean discounted return are both strictly below paired fixed evaluation.
gates.alternative_exists: For all 32 natural validation starts, replay a reference path that delivers exactly three within 128 ticks with zero trigger and zero lost grain. The path is feasibility evidence only.
gates.transition_locality: Enumerate all 24 actions across synthetic carried/source/ripeness/facing controls plus fixed rebuild-ready controls. Outside B full next states match; at B only carried_grain differs and harmful physical loss equals pre-harvest c.

source_policy.description: PACK S Dual final actor-critic after continued fixed-kernel learning
